mapper.select: select user_no from tb_user where user_id = #{user_id} and user_pw = SHA2(#{user_pw}, 256) and user_role = '99'

select m.master_no , m.title , date_format(m.reg_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as reg_date , count(q.question_no) as question_count from tb_question_master m left join tb_question q on q.master_no = m.master_no and q.use_yn = 'Y' where m.use_yn = 'Y' group by m.master_no, m.title, m.reg_date order by m.reg_date desc
mapper.insert: insert into tb_question_master (title, use_yn, reg_date, upd_date) values (#{title}, 'Y', now(), now())
mapper.update: update tb_question_master set use_yn = 'N' , upd_date = now() where master_no = #{master_no} and use_yn = 'Y'
update tb_answer set use_yn = 'N' where question_no in ( select question_no from tb_question where master_no = #{master_no} )
